newsitem.title: USA: Centennial to review probe results tonight.
newsitem.headline: Centennial to review probe results tonight.

text.p: Centennial Technologies Inc said Wednesday the special committee of its board will meet this evening after the stock market close to consider interim results of the review being conducted by the company and its independent auditors.
Centennial said it expects to issue a press release prior to the stock market opening Thursday containing "material information."
Because of the expected effect of the announcement, the company said it has asked the New York Stock Exchange to continue the trading halt in its shares until after the announcement.
Centennial shares rose sharply Tuesday, gaining 10-1/4 to 14-3/4 before trading in the stock was halted.

On February 18 the company said it expected to restate its financial results for fiscal 1996, ended last June 30, and for the first two quarters of fiscal 1997. It said it expected to report losses for all three periods and that "certain financial records of the company appear to have been falsified."
Centennial fired its founder chief executive officer, Emanuel Pinez, on February 11. He was subsequently arrested on suspicion of insider trading and securities fraud.
